performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 3.8 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 4.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Speed Index

performance.why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.9 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 2.7 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 8.5 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Total Blocking Time
performance.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive, when task length exceeded 50ms, expressed in milliseconds. [Learn more about the Total Blocking Time metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-total-blocking-time/).
performance.why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,310 ms). This delays user interaction.
performance.fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

performance.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
performance.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/articles/cls).
performance.why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.44). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.
performance.fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).

performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 2.5 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 3.2 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Total Blocking Time
performance.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive, when task length exceeded 50ms, expressed in milliseconds. [Learn more about the Total Blocking Time metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-total-blocking-time/).
performance.why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (400 ms). This delays user interaction.
performance.fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

performance.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
performance.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/articles/cls).
performance.why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.411). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.
performance.fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

performance.title: Speed Index

performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 2.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 3.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
performance.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/articles/cls).
performance.why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.41). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.
performance.fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).
performance.why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (4.6 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
performance.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).
performance.why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 54 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.
performance.fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

performance.title: Layout shift culprits

performance.why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 2.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 3.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
performance.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/articles/cls).
performance.why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.41). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.
performance.fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).
performance.why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes

performance.why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 50 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.
performance.fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 2.7 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 5.7 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
performance.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/articles/cls).
performance.why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.441). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.
performance.fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).
performance.why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
performance.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).
performance.why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 59 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.
performance.fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

performance.title: Layout shift culprits
performance.description: Layout shifts occur when elements move absent any user interaction. [Investigate the causes of layout shifts](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cls-culprit), such as elements being added, removed, or their fonts changing as the page loads.
performance.why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 2.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 2.7 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Total Blocking Time
performance.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive, when task length exceeded 50ms, expressed in milliseconds. [Learn more about the Total Blocking Time metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-total-blocking-time/).
performance.why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (320 ms). This delays user interaction.
performance.fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

performance.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
performance.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/articles/cls).

performance.fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

performance.title: Speed Index

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 2.7 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 3.9 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
performance.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/articles/cls).
performance.why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.425). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.
performance.fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).

performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.
